purpose: Prevent the Transformers model-level output recorder from retaining one quadratic attention tensor per layer during registered LongBench H2O utility cells, while preserving the official eager-attention and NVIDIA KVPress H2O execution path exactly.
execution_contract: Load and execute the official Transformers eager attention implementation without modifying its projections, rotary embeddings, causal mask, scaling, float32 softmax, bf16 cast, value aggregation, or returned attention tensor.
Execute the unchanged NVIDIA KVPress ObservedAttentionPress forward hook; it consumes each layer's returned attention tensor and applies the official H2O score, top-k, and cache-gather operations.

Pass output_attentions=false only to the outer Transformers model so its read-only output recorder is inactive; this flag does not suppress the eager attention tensor returned to the KVPress layer hook.
After the layer hook returns, the decoder discards the unrequested attention output instead of retaining it in a model-level tuple across all layers.
invariants: Do not use the query-chunked attention prototype in admitted formal runs.

Do not change model weights, attention implementation, H2O implementation, projections, masks, scaling, softmax precision, value aggregation, H2O normalization, top-k ordering, compression ratio, token budgets, prompts, or decoding.

Require bitwise equality of generated token IDs, output text, prompt and retained-cache lengths, press audits, and exact per-layer ordered top-k index digests between captured and uncaptured official eager paths on a feasible diagnostic sample before scale-up.
Require a successful uncaptured official-eager replay of a previously OOM 6k-plus-token sample before scale-up.
Use the identical uncaptured official-eager backend for the registered official H2O and Authority-H2O utility cells so paired comparisons are not confounded.
Treat every runtime error as a nonzero runner exit and exclude the run from closure.

incident.failure_mode: Transformers output_attentions=true activated a model-level recorder installed before experiment hooks; it retained one quadratic attention tensor per layer and reached approximately 75-76 GiB before a further 4-5.5 GiB allocation.
incident.insufficient_release_repair: A later release hook could not remove references already stored by the earlier Transformers recorder; its exact short audit and long-context OOM remain preserved.
incident.failed_chunked_repair: The query-chunked prototype reduced memory and passed a prior-OOM stress replay but changed floating-point accumulation, generated tokens, and exact per-layer H2O top-k sets; all failed diagnostics remain preserved and the prototype is forbidden in admitted formal runs.
incident.disposition: Archive the failed formal attempts without deleting raw outputs. Rerun the registered cells only after bitwise captured-versus-uncaptured official-eager equivalence and long-context stress gates pass.
